title: ONE PIECE CARD GAME Comprehensive Rules
note: A digest in the app's own words under the official section numbers, read in full from the official PDF at take 122. The official text governs; card text beats these rules where they disagree (1-3-1).

sim_legend.partial: the Sim keeps part of it; the rest is by hand
sim_legend.by hand: the players keep it; the Sim offers it or leaves it to them
sim_legend.not modelled: the Sim does not model this yet

sections.title: Players
sections.text: The game is for two players, head to head.

sections.title: Ending the game
sections.text: A player who meets a defeat condition loses and the other wins. Defeat is checked at the next rule processing.

sections.title: The two defeat conditions
sections.text: You lose when your Leader takes damage while you have 0 Life cards, or when you have 0 cards in your deck.

sections.title: Conceding
sections.text: Either player may concede at any time; they lose at once and no card can stop or force it.

sections.title: Winning or losing by a card
sections.text: Some cards make a player win or lose; that happens while the effect is processed.

sections.title: Card text beats the rules
sections.text: When a card's text contradicts these rules, the card text wins.

sections.title: Impossible actions
sections.text: An action that cannot be done is not done; of several actions, do as many as possible. Changing a card to the state it is already in does nothing.

sections.title: Simultaneous choices
sections.text: When both players choose at once, the turn player chooses first.

sections.title: Choosing numbers
sections.text: A chosen number is a whole number of 0 or more; with no minimum, 0 may be chosen.

sections.title: Numbers that change
sections.text: Numbers have no fractions. Power can go below 0; other numbers below 0 count as 0. A negative cost counts only inside its own calculation.

sections.title: Negative cost
sections.text: A cost made negative by an effect is 0 outside that calculation.

sections.title: Order of text
sections.text: Card effects are carried out in the order written.

sections.title: Rest beats set active
sections.text: If an effect would rest a card and set it active at the same time, it is rested.

sections.title: Cost and activation cost
sections.text: Cost is paid to play a card; an activation cost is paid to activate an effect.

sections.title: Both players act
sections.text: When an effect makes both players act at the same time, the turn player acts first.

sections.title: Card information
sections.text: What is printed on a card: name, category, colour, type, attribute, power, cost, text, Life, Counter, [Trigger], card number.

sections.title: Card name
sections.text: A name in [ ] with no noun after it means cards with that name; part of a name in quotes means names containing it. Some cards take a name from their text.

sections.title: Card categories
sections.text: Five categories: Leader, Character, Event, Stage and DON!!. A Leader stays in the Leader area, Characters in the Character area, Stages in the Stage area; an Event is used from hand.

sections.title: Colour
sections.text: Six colours: red, green, blue, purple, black and yellow. A card of several colours is every one of them.

sections.title: Several colours
sections.text: A card of several colours counts as every one of them.

sections.title: Type
sections.text: A card may have several types, split by a slash. A type in { } in text means cards of that type; part of a type in quotes means types containing it.

sections.title: A type in { }
sections.text: Text in { } brackets means cards with that type.

sections.title: Part of a type in quotes
sections.text: A part of a type in " " quotation marks means cards with a type containing that text.

sections.title: Attribute
sections.text: Slash, Strike, Ranged, Special, Wisdom and ?. Only Leaders and Characters have one; an attribute in < > means cards with it.

sections.title: Power
sections.text: Only Leaders and Characters have power; effects can raise or lower it.

sections.title: Power can change
sections.text: Effects can make power higher or lower than printed; 'N power or less' reads the power the card has now.

sections.title: Cost
sections.text: To play a card from hand, reveal it and rest that many active DON!! in your cost area. An Event is then trashed and its effect resolves. Only Characters, Events and Stages have a cost.

sections.title: Playing a Character
sections.text: Reveal it, rest active DON!! equal to its cost, then play it.

sections.title: Using an Event
sections.text: Reveal it, rest active DON!! equal to its cost, trash it, then activate and resolve its effect.

sections.title: Card text
sections.text: A Leader's, Character's or Stage's text works only in its own area unless it says otherwise. Text resolves from the top. Words in ( ) explain and do not change play.

sections.title: Life
sections.text: At the start, each player places Life cards equal to the Leader's Life from the top of the deck, face-down, without looking.

sections.title: Life order
sections.text: The card that was on top of the deck goes to the bottom of the Life area.

sections.title: Counter value
sections.text: The power a Character card in hand adds in the Counter Step. Only Characters have one; with several, only the highest applies.

sections.title: [Trigger]
sections.text: An effect that can be used instead of adding the card to hand when it comes from Life on taking damage.

sections.title: Card number
sections.text: No more than 4 cards with the same card number in a deck.

sections.title: Four copies
sections.text: No more than 4 cards with the same card number in a deck.

sections.title: The areas
sections.text: Deck, DON!! deck, hand, trash, Leader, Character, Stage, cost and Life areas. How many cards each holds is open to both players. 'The field' is the Leader, Character, Stage and cost areas.

sections.title: A card that moves is a new card
sections.text: A card leaving the Character or Stage area becomes a new card wherever it goes; what applied to it does not follow. A DON!! that moves loses what applied to it.

sections.title: Deck
sections.text: Face-down; nobody looks at or reorders it unless told. Several cards moved from it move one at a time. Shuffling puts it in random order.

sections.title: DON!! deck
sections.text: Open, face-down; either player may look at it.

sections.title: Hand
sections.text: Secret to the other player; you may look at and reorder your own.
sections.where: paintSim (the other hand is a count)

sections.title: Trash
sections.text: K.O.'d Characters and used Events go here, face-up, open to both; new cards go on top.

sections.title: Leader area
sections.text: Your Leader is placed face-up at the start and never leaves by any rule or effect.

sections.title: The Leader starts in play
sections.text: The Leader is placed face-up at the start of the game; it is never played from hand.

sections.title: Character area
sections.text: Characters are played face-up and active unless told otherwise.

sections.title: Played this turn
sections.text: A Character played this turn cannot attack unless an effect says it can ([Rush], [Rush: Character]).

sections.title: Five Characters
sections.text: Up to 5 Characters can be in the Character area.

sections.title: A sixth Character
sections.text: With 5 in play, to play another you reveal it, trash one of your 5, then play it. That trash is rule processing, not a K.O.: no effect applies.

sections.title: Trashing for room is a rule
sections.text: Trashing a Character to make room for a sixth is rule processing: no effect applies, and it is not a K.O.

sections.title: Stage area
sections.text: Stages are played face-up and active unless told otherwise.

sections.title: One Stage
sections.text: Up to 1 Stage. To play a new one, reveal it, trash the old one, then play it.

sections.title: A new Stage
sections.text: Playing a Stage with one already in play trashes the old one first.

sections.title: Cost area
sections.text: DON!! are placed here, active unless told otherwise. It is open; you choose which DON!! pay a cost.

sections.title: Life area
sections.text: Secret and face-down; nobody looks or reorders. A card leaving Life comes from the top unless told otherwise. A card added face-up is open.

sections.title: Active and rested
sections.text: Cards on the field are active (upright) or rested (sideways). A given DON!! is neither.

sections.title: Draw
sections.text: Add the top card of your deck to your hand without showing it. 'Draw up to X' lets you stop after any card.

sections.title: Damage
sections.text: For each point of damage, the damaged player moves the top Life card to hand. A card with [Trigger] may be activated instead.

sections.title: Play a card
sections.text: Pay its cost and use it or put it into play from hand.

sections.title: Up to X
sections.text: Choose any number from 0 to X, then resolve.

sections.title: Base power and base cost
sections.text: When several effects set a card's base power or base cost to different values, the highest applies.

sections.title: If and Then
sections.text: If an 'if' clause cannot be met, what follows it is not resolved. If a 'then' clause cannot be resolved, what follows it still can, unless an 'if' before it failed.

sections.title: Remove
sections.text: Remove means move a card from its area to another area.

sections.title: Game setup
sections.text: Decks are prepared (5-1) and the game is set up (5-2).

sections.title: Leader, deck and DON!! deck
sections.text: Each player brings 1 Leader, a 50-card deck and a 10-card DON!! deck.

sections.title: A deck
sections.text: Exactly 1 Leader, a 50-card deck of Characters, Events and Stages, and a 10-card DON!! deck.

sections.title: What a deck holds
sections.text: Characters, Events and Stages only.

sections.title: Colours
sections.text: Every card must share a colour with the Leader.

sections.title: Copies
sections.text: No more than 4 cards with the same card number.

sections.title: Cards that change deck building
sections.text: Effects about deck construction replace these rules; they are permanent effects that work during deck building.

sections.title: Before the game
sections.text: Check the decks, shuffle, place the Leaders, decide who goes first, draw 5 with one redraw each, place Life, and the first player begins.

sections.title: Shuffle
sections.text: Each player shuffles thoroughly and places the deck face-down.

sections.title: Leaders
sections.text: Each player places their Leader face-up.

sections.title: Who chooses
sections.text: Rock-paper-scissors or another fair way decides who chooses to go first or second.

sections.title: At the start of the game
sections.text: Leader effects that say 'At the start of the game' are processed now, the chooser's first.

sections.title: Opening hand and redraw
sections.text: Each player draws 5; starting with the first player, each may once return all 5, reshuffle and draw 5.

sections.title: Life
sections.text: Each player places Life equal to the Leader's Life from the top of the deck, the deck's top card at the bottom of Life.

sections.title: The first turn
sections.text: The first player begins their turn.

sections.title: Game progression
sections.text: The turn player plays the five phases in order: Refresh, Draw, DON!!, Main, End.

sections.title: A turn
sections.text: Refresh Phase, Draw Phase, DON!! Phase, Main Phase, End Phase.

sections.title: Refresh Phase
sections.text: Effects 'until the start of your next turn' end; 'at the start of your turn' effects activate; given DON!! return to your cost area rested; then every rested card of yours is set active.
sections.where: SIM.startTurn ('at the start of your turn' is by hand)

sections.title: Until your next turn ends
sections.text: Effects lasting 'until the start of your next turn' end in your Refresh Phase.

sections.title: Given DON!! come home
sections.text: DON!! given to your Leader and Characters return to your cost area, rested.

sections.title: Everything stands up
sections.text: All your rested Leader, Characters, Stage and DON!! are set active.

sections.title: Draw Phase
sections.text: Draw 1. The first player does not draw on their first turn.

sections.title: Draw one
sections.text: The turn player draws 1; the first player skips it on their first turn.

sections.title: DON!! Phase
sections.text: Place 2 DON!! from the DON!! deck in the cost area, face-up (1 for the first player's first turn; only what the DON!! deck has).

sections.title: Two DON!!
sections.text: Place 2 DON!! face-up in the cost area; the first player places 1 on their first turn.

sections.title: One left
sections.text: With 1 card in the DON!! deck, place 1.

sections.title: None left
sections.text: With 0 cards in the DON!! deck, place none.

sections.title: Main Phase
sections.text: In any order, as often as you like: play cards, activate effects, give DON!!, battle. Declare the end to go to the End Phase.

sections.title: Ending the Main Phase
sections.text: Declaring the end of the Main Phase moves to the End Phase.

sections.title: Play a card
sections.text: Pay the cost to play a Character or Stage, or to use an Event with [Main], from your hand.

sections.title: What the Main Phase plays
sections.text: Characters, Stages, and Events marked [Main].

sections.title: Activate an effect
sections.text: The turn player may activate [Main] and [Activate: Main] effects.

sections.title: Give DON!!
sections.text: Place an active DON!! from your cost area under your Leader or a Character. Do it as often as you can.

sections.title: How to give
sections.text: One active DON!! from the cost area, under the Leader or a Character, still visible.

sections.title: +1000 on your turn
sections.text: A Leader or Character gains 1000 power during your turn for each DON!! given to it. On the opponent's turn it gains nothing.

sections.title: A card that leaves
sections.text: When a card with given DON!! moves to another area, its DON!! go to the cost area, rested.

sections.title: Battle
sections.text: Attack during the Main Phase (7).

sections.title: No battle on a first turn
sections.text: Neither player can battle on their own first turn.

sections.title: End Phase
sections.text: [End of Your Turn] effects resolve, then the other player's [End of Your Opponent's Turn]; each only once. Then what lasts 'this turn' ends, and the other player's turn begins.

sections.title: End Phase effects
sections.text: [End of Your Turn] and [End of Your Opponent's Turn] effects activate and resolve once each, the turn player's first, each player choosing their own order.

sections.title: Whose End Phase effects first
sections.text: The turn player's [End of Your Turn] effects, then the other player's [End of Your Opponent's Turn] effects.

sections.title: This turn ends
sections.text: Effects lasting 'during this turn' end, the turn player's first.

sections.title: Attacks and battles
sections.text: An attack runs the Attack, Block, Counter and Damage Steps, then the battle ends.

sections.title: Attacking
sections.text: In your Main Phase, rest your active Leader or an active Character to attack the opponent's Leader or one of their rested Characters. The battle then runs the Attack, Block, Counter and Damage Steps.

sections.title: Attack Step
sections.text: Declare the attack by resting the attacker, choose the target, then [When Attacking] and [On Your Opponent's Attack] effects activate.

sections.title: The attacker rests
sections.text: Only an active Leader or Character attacks, and it is rested to do so.

sections.title: The target
sections.text: The opponent's Leader, or one of their rested Characters.

sections.title: Attack Step effects
sections.text: [When Attacking], 'when you attack', [On Your Opponent's Attack] and 'when attacked' effects activate.

sections.title: A card leaves in the Attack Step
sections.text: If the attacker or the target has left its area by the end of the Attack Step, skip to the end of the battle.

sections.title: Block Step
sections.text: The attacked player may activate one [Blocker] once in that battle; [On Block] effects then activate.

sections.title: A card leaves in the Block Step
sections.text: If the attacker or the target has left, skip to the end of the battle.

sections.title: Counter Step
sections.text: The attacked player may, as often as they like, trash Characters with a Counter value from hand to add that power for the battle, and pay for and use [Counter] Events.

sections.title: Counter from hand
sections.text: Trash a Character with a Counter value from hand; its value is added to the Leader or 1 Character for the battle.

sections.title: [Counter] Events
sections.text: Pay the Event's cost, trash it, and activate its [Counter] effect.

sections.title: A card leaves in the Counter Step
sections.text: If the attacker or the target has left, skip to the end of the battle.

sections.title: Damage Step
sections.text: If the attacker's power is equal or higher, it wins: a Leader takes 1 damage, a Character is K.O.'d. Otherwise nothing happens.

sections.title: Ties go to the attacker
sections.text: The attacker wins when its power is greater than or equal to the defender's.

sections.title: No Life when damage comes
sections.text: If the opponent has 0 Life when the damage is determined, the attacker wins the game.

sections.title: Taking the Life card
sections.text: With 1 or more Life, the top Life card goes to hand, or its [Trigger] is revealed and activated instead.

sections.title: Two damage
sections.text: With 2 or more damage ([Double Attack]), the Life step repeats that many times. At 1 Life the last card is taken and the game goes on.

sections.title: End of the Battle
sections.text: The battle ends; 'at the end of this battle' effects activate; effects lasting 'during this battle' end.

sections.title: Activating and resolving effects
sections.text: The kinds of effect, their costs and conditions, and the order they resolve in.

sections.title: Effects
sections.text: An effect is what a card's text and its cost command. 'May' and 'up to' let a player not use it; otherwise it must be used as far as possible.

sections.title: Auto effects
sections.text: Activate once, by themselves, each time their timing happens: [On Play], [When Attacking], [On Block], [On K.O.], [End of Your Turn], [End of Your Opponent's Turn].

sections.title: A card that moved
sections.text: An auto effect does not activate if its card moved to another area before it activated.

sections.title: Activate effects
sections.text: Used by the player in the Main Phase: [Activate: Main] and [Main].

sections.title: Permanent effects
sections.text: Always on while their conditions hold, such as '[DON!! x1] This Character gains +1000 power.'
sections.where: SIM.power, SIM.kwOf, a condition in words included (ST09-001); a continuous line no template reads is kept and the board says it is the player's to apply (SIM.unapplied)

sections.title: Replacement effects
sections.text: Effects that say 'instead'. The card that made the replacement first, then the turn player's, then the other player's; the same replacement never twice.

sections.title: A replacement mid-effect
sections.text: A replacement replaces all of the processing it names; the rest of the text continues after it.

sections.title: One-shot and continuous
sections.text: A one-shot effect finishes at once; a continuous one lasts for its stated time.

sections.title: Valid and invalid effects
sections.text: An effect made invalid does not happen, asks no choice and takes no cost. Effects already resolved stay resolved.

sections.title: Activation cost and conditions
sections.text: What comes before the colon is the activation cost, paid in order. A cost that cannot be paid in full cannot be paid at all. 'You may' costs can be declined, which declines the effect.

sections.title: Several costs
sections.text: An activation cost of several actions is paid in order, from the first printed; once begun it is paid in full.
sections.where: SIM.costsPayable; act('fxskip') refused while a begun cost can be paid

sections.title: A cost that cannot be paid
sections.text: If any of the activation cost cannot be paid, none of it is paid and the effect is not activated.

sections.title: The rest-DON!! symbol
sections.text: Rest that many active DON!! from your cost area.
sections.where: SIM.DO.cost_restdon; several costs in a row are paid in order and in full (SIM.costsPayable, act fxskip)

sections.title: DON!! -X
sections.text: Return X DON!! from your Leader, Characters and cost area to your DON!! deck.

sections.title: Conditions
sections.text: [DON!! xX], [Your Turn], [Opponent's Turn] and the like must all be met; 'if' clauses too.

sections.title: [DON!! xX]
sections.text: Met while this card has X or more DON!! given to it.

sections.title: Activating and resolving
sections.text: Meet the conditions, name the effect (reveal it if from hand), pay the costs, activate, resolve. An Event is trashed first. Choices are made while resolving.

sections.title: An Event's effect
sections.text: Trash the Event, then carry out its effect.

sections.title: Choosing
sections.text: Choose as many as you can up to the number; with 'up to', 0 is allowed.

sections.title: Moving to an open area
sections.text: Auto effects that trigger on a card moving activate only if it moved to an open area (such as [On K.O.]).

sections.title: Order of resolution
sections.text: When both players' effects trigger together, the turn player's resolve first; effects triggered while resolving wait their turn in that order.

sections.title: Triggers during damage
sections.text: Effects triggered during damage wait until all the damage is done; a [Trigger] may pause the damage to be revealed and used.

sections.title: Rule processing
sections.text: What the rules do on their own the moment it happens: the defeat checks.

sections.title: Rule processing
sections.text: Done automatically the moment its event happens, even in the middle of other actions.

sections.title: Defeat judgment
sections.text: Every player who meets a defeat condition loses; if both do, both lose.

sections.title: Damage at 0 Life
sections.text: A Leader taking damage with 0 Life cards.

sections.title: An empty deck
sections.text: 0 cards in the deck is a defeat at once, not only when a draw fails.

sections.title: Keyword effects and keywords
sections.text: The keyword effects ([Rush], [Double Attack], [Banish], [Blocker], [Trigger], [Rush: Character], [Unblockable]) and the keywords of timing and condition.

sections.title: [Rush]
sections.text: This Character can attack on the turn it is played.

sections.title: [Double Attack]
sections.text: Damage this card deals to a Leader is 2.

sections.title: [Banish]
sections.text: Life cards this card's damage takes are trashed instead of going to hand, and their [Trigger] does not activate.

sections.title: [Blocker]
sections.text: When another of your cards is attacked, rest this card in the Block Step to become the new target.

sections.title: Blocking for another card
sections.text: A [Blocker] protects one of your other cards; it cannot block an attack on itself.

sections.title: [Trigger]
sections.text: On taking damage, reveal the Life card and use its [Trigger] instead of adding it to hand, or add it to hand without revealing. A used [Trigger] card is trashed afterwards.

sections.title: After a [Trigger]
sections.text: The card is in no area while its [Trigger] resolves, then it is trashed unless told otherwise.

sections.title: [Rush: Character]
sections.text: This Character can attack Characters on the turn it is played.

sections.title: [Unblockable]
sections.text: The opponent cannot activate [Blocker] against this card's attack.

sections.title: Keywords
sections.text: K.O., the timings ([Activate: Main], [Main], [Counter], [When Attacking], [On Play], [End of Your Turn], [End of Your Opponent's Turn], [On Block], [On Your Opponent's Attack], [On K.O.]), the conditions ([DON!! xX], [Your Turn], [Opponent's Turn]), DON!! -X, [Once Per Turn] and Trash.

sections.title: K.O.
sections.text: A Character trashed by losing a battle or by an effect that says K.O. [On K.O.] and 'cannot be K.O.'d' apply only to those; trashed any other way is not a K.O.

sections.title: [Activate: Main]
sections.text: Can be activated in your Main Phase, but not during a battle.

sections.title: [Main]
sections.text: Found on Events: used from hand in your Main Phase, not during a battle.

sections.title: [Counter]
sections.text: Found on Events: used from hand in the Counter Step when your card is attacked. An effect cannot use it unless it says 'activate [Counter]'.

sections.title: [When Attacking]
sections.text: Activates when you declare an attack in your Attack Step.

sections.title: [On Play]
sections.text: Activates when the card is played.

sections.title: [End of Your Turn]
sections.text: Activates in your End Phase.

sections.title: [End of Your Opponent's Turn]
sections.text: Activates in your opponent's End Phase.

sections.title: [DON!! xX]
sections.text: A condition met while this card has X or more DON!! given to it.

sections.title: DON!! -X
sections.text: Return X DON!! from your Leader, Characters and cost area to your DON!! deck.

sections.title: [Your Turn]
sections.text: A condition met during your turn.

sections.title: [Opponent's Turn]
sections.text: A condition met during your opponent's turn.

sections.title: [Once Per Turn]
sections.text: The effect can be activated and resolved once a turn, once for each card that has it. A card that leaves the field and returns is a new card and may use it again. If its cost fails mid-payment, it is still used.

sections.title: A card that returns
sections.text: A card that leaves the field after using its [Once Per Turn] effect and comes back is a different card and may use it again.

sections.title: Trash
sections.text: Choose a card from the hand and place it in the trash.

sections.title: [On Block]
sections.text: Activates in the Block Step when you activate [Blocker].

sections.title: [On Your Opponent's Attack]
sections.text: Activates when your opponent declares an attack, after [When Attacking] and the other Attack Step effects.

sections.title: [On K.O.]
sections.text: When the card is K.O.'d on the field, the effect is activated there if its conditions are met; the card is trashed and the effect resolves from the trash.

sections.title: Infinite loops
sections.text: If nobody can stop a loop, the game is a draw. If one player can, they say how many times it runs. If both can, the smaller number runs.

sections.title: Revealing cards
sections.text: A card moved from one secret area to another is always revealed.

sections.title: Looking at secret areas
sections.text: Only the effect's player looks, the cards stay in their area while looked at, and cards not moved go back as they were.

sections.title: Looked-at cards stay put
sections.text: Cards being looked at remain in their area while looked at (a deck being searched is not empty).

sections.title: Back as they were
sections.text: After looking, cards the text does not move go back to their area as they were.
